code_summary: The intended architecture is an independent MultVAE–SASRec ensemble per dataset across all four categories. MultVAE reconstructs binary histories using normalized inputs, a 256-unit hidden layer and 64-dimensional latent representation. SASRec uses 50-dimensional shared item embeddings, length-50 sequences, two causal Transformer blocks, and positive-plus-16-negative cross-entropy. The rollback removes the transition branch and scores Transformer features directly against item embeddings. Independently selected member checkpoints feed equal-weight mean-rank fusion; the generated predictor strictly reloads both models and preserves dataset routing. Training seed remains 42 and the epoch default is 200. Checkpoint and predictor agreement checks were included but never executed.
